title: Add OPTIONS support for public routes
objective: Support OPTIONS requests on public routes so clients can discover allowed methods without receiving a response body.
scope: Advertise allowed methods for public routes
Update 405 Allow headers to include OPTIONS
Add tests, documentation, test evidence, and handoff

required_tests: Regression test for 405 Allow header and full server behavior

reasons: Small HTTP discovery behavior change only
